title: Sparkly banana
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bananaGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFD11A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F5B800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bananaShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFC400'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E09B00'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Banana body -->
  <path d='M 20 72 C 22 48, 40 26, 66 20 C 74 18, 80 22, 78 28 C 76 34, 68 36, 62 40 C 50 47, 40 56, 36 68 C 34 76, 26 80, 20 72 Z'
        fill='url(#bananaGrad)' stroke='#FFC400' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Banana inner shade for depth -->
  <path d='M 30 68 C 34 52, 46 36, 66 28 C 70 26, 74 27, 73 31 C 60 40, 46 52, 42 68 C 40 74, 32 74, 30 68 Z'
        fill='url(#bananaShade)' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- Banana tip highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='24' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FFF3B0' transform='rotate(-30 72 24)'/>

  <!-- Banana stem nub -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='74' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#C98A00' transform='rotate(20 20 74)'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='73' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#E8B83A' transform='rotate(20 20 73)'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFFDE0'>
    <!-- Sparkle 1 (top right) -->
    <path d='M 82 12 L 84 18 L 90 20 L 84 22 L 82 28 L 80 22 L 74 20 L 80 18 Z'/>
    <!-- Sparkle 2 (left) -->
    <path d='M 12 44 L 13.5 48 L 18 50 L 13.5 52 L 12 56 L 10.5 52 L 6 50 L 10.5 48 Z'/>
    <!-- Sparkle 3 (bottom right) -->
    <path d='M 86 62 L 87.5 66 L 92 68 L 87.5 70 L 86 74 L 84.5 70 L 80 68 L 84.5 66 Z'/>
    <!-- Sparkle 4 (top) -->
    <path d='M 50 6 L 51.2 9.5 L 55 10.5 L 51.2 11.5 L 50 15 L 48.8 11.5 L 45 10.5 L 48.8 9.5 Z'/>
    <!-- Sparkle 5 (small, near banana) -->
    <path d='M 66 50 L 67 53 L 70 54 L 67 55 L 66 58 L 65 55 L 62 54 L 65 53 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
